question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The **basilica **was renowned for its acoustics and proportions.

options.text: The archaeologist uncovered the foundations of a Roman basilica.
The musician composed an oratorio for performance in the basilica.
The botanist catalogued a rare basilica with serrated leaves.
Pilgrims gathered inside the ancient basilica at dusk.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The botanist catalogued a rare basilica with serrated leaves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **homonym** is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation as another word but has a different meaning.
 
• The highlighted word in the question is **basilica**, which refers to a large and important church building.
 
• In Option 3, **basilica** refers to a rare plant catalogued by the botanist, which is a different meaning of the same word.

Correct sentence: *The botanist catalogued a rare basilica with serrated leaves.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Homonyms can either be **homophones** (words that sound the same but have different meanings or spellings) or **homographs** (words that are spelled the same but have different meanings).
 
• In this case, **basilica** is a homograph, as it has the same spelling but different meanings in different contexts.
